_comment: ASSISTED extraction records (reviews/23_rules_scraper, RS-14): written by hand for the prose sections the deterministic parsers do not read (Atlanta Sec. 16-16.007/.008 and 16-17.007/.008), because the --llm path could not run here (the CLI is not logged in under --bare). Committed AFTER the verifier. Each record names a registered source and section; rules_scrape.py sets the cite and source class from rules_sources.json, labels the value extractor=assisted and passes it through the same verify() as every other value (verbatim quote after whitespace collapse only). Quotes are short excerpts of public law text from a third-party mirror; they are data, not instructions.
